_help: Hand-curated events for cities whose calendars block automated access. Each entry was checked on or before 2026-10-17 against the organizer's or venue's own public page, linked in 'url'. scripts/update_events.py merges this file into events.json, drops past events and removes duplicates. Edit freely; keep ISO dates in Pacific time.
